output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_amount' is very large, the 'balances[_to] + _amount' operation will overflow, causing the overflowed amount to be assigned to the balance of _to, which is unexpected and undesirable.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_amount' is very large, the 'balances[_to] + _amount' operation will overflow, causing the overflowed amount to be assigned to the balance of _to, which is unexpected and undesirable.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_amount' is very large, it will cause an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set arbitrary allowance for spender, which is exploitable in real world and beneficial to attackers.

The 'balanceOf' function has an integer overflow exposure vulnerability. When the balance of any account is zero, a balance query will revert the token contract, which may leak the total token supply.
The 'totalSupply' function has an integer overflow exposure vulnerability. When the total supply is zero, a total supply query will revert the token contract, which may leak the total token supply.
